title: Cadence Lifts Full-Year 2026 Guidance After Beating Q3 Estimates
summary:
Cadence reported third-quarter revenue of $1.63B, surpassing analyst estimates of $1.61B, and adjusted earnings per share of $2.11, which topped the predicted $2.05. The company increased its full-year 2026 revenue outlook to a range of $6.39B to $6.42B, compared with the $6.32B estimated by analysts, and raised its adjusted EPS guidance to between $8.37 and $8.43 from $8.16.

The chip design software provider authorized an additional $2.5B for share repurchases and reported a record backlog of $8.2B. Cadence also launched Maestro, a portfolio of domain-specialized AI models for chip and system design, though it noted a non-GAAP operating margin of 44.1%, a decrease of 350 basis points from a year earlier.
